thread:
jane (PM): customer ACME asked for a compact evidence export that is queryable for 7 years and must be encrypted with their BYOK escrow policy. asking for feasibility + launch asks.
omar (eng): do we have a rough spec from them? fields, query types, retention windows?
jane (PM): they want event-level audit (create/update/delete) + full prompt/response blobs for 90 days, then compacted index for 7 yrs. search across all tenants but filtered by tenant-id.
paul (sre): big Q: search SLA on long-tail cold store. We should set expectations: warm (0-30d): <3s; cold (30d-7y): best-effort up to 2m. customers asked for 10s across 7y — that's expensive.
emma (legal): ACME requires chain-of-custody logs (who exported, when, signed hash). also retention deletion proof for legal-hold.
kai (ops): BYOK escrow: they want escrow key rotation + annual auditor access. We need KMS + escrow workflow + escrow SLA (response within 48h).
omar (eng): implementation sketch: write compacted index that stores per-event metadata + tokenized snippet references. keep full blobs for 90d. Add tenant-level encryption keys (CMEK) and support key-escrow handshake.
paul (sre): ops concerns: exporting large evidence sets will spike IO. propose "export-sandbox" job that streams to S3 in ACME VPC or signed transfer, rate-limited. also add job retry and idempotency.
jane (PM): launch criteria proposal: (1) export tool can deliver filtered export (tenant + time-range) with signed manifest; (2) BYOK key handshake + escrow flow tested; (3) SOC2 evidence export test-suite green; (4) search SLA doc published.
emma (legal): + (5) proof-of-deletion audit: must demonstrate object removed and manifest updated.
omar (eng): sample config for retention/compaction (for discussion):
```
retention.default_days: 90
retention.compacted_days: 2555  # ~7 years
retention.compaction_policy: daily -> hourly-index -> compacted-index
export.sandbox: true
search.sla.warm_seconds: 3
search.sla.cold_seconds: 120
```
kai (ops): + suggestion: canary rollout per customer tier. start with dev/psa customers, then pilot ACME on dedicated capacity.
paul (sre): fallback policy: if cold search fails under SLA, return metadata-only results and queued re-hydration. document fallback in API contract.
jane (PM): prioritization ask: product wants this in Q3 pilot. engineering estimate?
omar (eng): rough T-shirt: M (6-8 wks) for core export + compaction + CMEK plumbing if we reuse existing keystore APIs; L (12-16 wks) if we need new escrow UI and auditor workflows.
emma (legal): we can scope UI later; must ship escrow proofing and manifest signatures first.
paul (sre): operational readiness: runbook for large export, throttling knobs, eskew job to avoid OOMs, and SLA playbook.
kai (ops): I'll stub runbook and ops checklist. also: add retention toggle per-tenant (opt-in longer retention) and audit trail for toggles.
jane (PM): decision needed: (A) accept ACME's 10s across 7y ask (costly) OR (B) offer 10s for 90d and 2m for rest with compensation. prefer B + pilot. thoughts?
emma (legal): go with B; document in contract with explicit SLA and cost offset.
omar (eng): agree. will draft tech spec and link here: <https://redwood.internal/docs/specs/evidence-compact-export>
paul (sre): :thumbsup: once spec is up, I'll review for operational limits.
deploy-bot: scheduled export-pilot cluster will be provisioned on 3067891400 (ETA)
jane (PM): thanks team — I'll schedule a scoping meeting with ACME + infra next week. items: spec, pilot timeline, legal terms, ops runbook.
notes: short thread, coordinating product/eng/legal/ops on enterprise evidence export, retention windows, BYOK escrow, SLAs, and rollout plan
